answer: LINE (second-order proximity) defines the conditional probability of generating context vertex v_j given vertex v_i as a softmax over inner products: p2(v_j|v_i) = exp(u_j^T u_i) / Σ_{k∈V} exp(u_k^T u_i), where u_i is the embedding of v_i and u_j is the context embedding of v_j. This distribution is defined over the entire vertex set V, so the denominator sums over all vertices in the network.
confidence_reasoning: I am fairly confident this matches the softmax formulation over all vertices in LINE (Tang et al., 2015), though exact notation may vary across descriptions of the paper.
